```mjs title=runtime.mjs

var __webpack_modules__ = {};
// The module cache
var __webpack_module_cache__ = {};
// The require function
function __webpack_require__(moduleId) {
// Check if module is in cache
var cachedModule = __webpack_module_cache__[moduleId];
if (cachedModule !== undefined) {
return cachedModule.exports;
}
// Create a new module (and put it into the cache)
var module = (__webpack_module_cache__[moduleId] = {
exports: {}
});
// Execute the module function
__webpack_modules__[moduleId](module, module.exports, __webpack_require__);

// Return the exports of the module
return module.exports;
}
// expose the modules object (__webpack_modules__)
__webpack_require__.m = __webpack_modules__;

// webpack/runtime/esm_register_module
(() => {
__webpack_require__.add = function registerModules(modules) { Object.assign(__webpack_require__.m, modules) }

})();

export { __webpack_require__ };

```

```mjs title=safe.mjs
import { __webpack_require__ } from "./runtime.mjs";

__webpack_require__.add({
"./safe.cjs"
/*!******************!*\
  !*** ./safe.cjs ***!
  \******************/
(module) {
module.exports = require("external");


},
});
// ./entry-safe.js
const external = __webpack_require__(/*! ./safe.cjs */ "./safe.cjs");

process.__mixedExternalValues.push(external);

const value = external.value;

export { value };

```

```mjs title=unsafe.mjs
import { __webpack_require__ } from "./runtime.mjs";

__webpack_require__.add({
"./. sync recursive"
/*!****************!*\
  !*** ./.|sync ***!
  \****************/
(module) {
function __rspack_empty_context(req) {
  var e = new Error("Cannot find module '" + req + "'");
  e.code = 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND';
  throw e;
}
__rspack_empty_context.keys = () => ([]);
__rspack_empty_context.resolve = __rspack_empty_context;
__rspack_empty_context.id = "./. sync recursive";
module.exports = __rspack_empty_context;


},
"external"
/*!***************************!*\
  !*** external "external" ***!
  \***************************/
(module) {
module.exports = require("external");

},
"./local.cjs"
/*!*******************!*\
  !*** ./local.cjs ***!
  \*******************/
(__unused_rspack_module, exports) {
exports.value = 7;


},
"./unsafe.cjs"
/*!********************!*\
  !*** ./unsafe.cjs ***!
  \********************/
(module, __unused_rspack_exports, __webpack_require__) {
const selected = __webpack_require__(
	globalThis.__USE_EXTERNAL__ ? /*! external */ "external" : /*! ./local.cjs */ "./local.cjs"
);

const contextual = globalThis.__RUN_DYNAMIC_CONTEXT__
	? __webpack_require__(/*! . */ "./. sync recursive")(globalThis.__USE_CONTEXT_EXTERNAL__
				? /*! external */ "external"
				: "./" + globalThis.__LOCAL_MODULE__)
	: __webpack_require__(/*! ./local.cjs */ "./local.cjs");

module.exports = { selected, contextual };


},
});
// ./entry-unsafe.js
globalThis.__USE_EXTERNAL__ = true;
globalThis.__RUN_DYNAMIC_CONTEXT__ = false;
globalThis.__USE_CONTEXT_EXTERNAL__ = false;
globalThis.__LOCAL_MODULE__ = "local.cjs";

const { selected: selected, contextual: contextual } = __webpack_require__(/*! ./unsafe.cjs */ "./unsafe.cjs");

process.__mixedExternalValues.push(selected);

if (contextual.value !== 7) {
	throw new Error("dynamic CommonJS context fallback should keep working");
}

const value = selected.value;

export { value };
```
